comment: P5.3 frozen scene set. f0 = 0-based frame index (frame file = f0+1 as %06d.jpg; GT line = f0+1). distractor_box = hand-annotated pixel box at f0 (1280x720), verified visually 2026-07-14 (see README curation section).
